configurationFields.label: Server Configuration File Options
configurationFields.description: Specifies [configuration file options](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/configuration-options/) to include in 'mongod.conf' for the MongoDB server that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Must be in YAML format. Use with care

configurationFields.label: Additional Server Command Line Options
configurationFields.description: Specifies [additional command line options](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/program/mongod/#options) for the MongoDB server that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care

configurationFields.label: Additional Client Command Line Options
configurationFields.description: Specifies [additional command line options](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-shell/reference/options/) for the MongoDB client run by GSCS (a root user called 'admin') that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care

configurationFields.label: MongoDB Release Stream
configurationFields.description: Sets the MongoDB release stream from which to install the latest version, unless a specific version is specified under MongoDB Version. Check [system compatibility](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/administration/production-notes/#platform-support-matrix). WARNING: SWITCHING BETWEEN RELEASE STREAMS OR DOWNGRADING VERSIONS MAY CORRUPT DATA! Update the server after changing this setting

configurationFields.label: MongoDB Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the [MongoDB version](https://www.mongodb.com/try/download/community-edition/releases/archive) to install. Empty = latest version for the release stream specified under MongoDB Release Stream. Check [system compatibility](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/administration/production-notes/#platform-support-matrix). WARNING: SWITCHING BETWEEN RELEASE STREAMS OR DOWNGRADING VERSIONS MAY CORRUPT DATA! Update the server after changing this setting

deploymentSteps.name: Download MongoDB
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $MongoDBRelease='{SERVERVERSION}'; $MongoDBVersion='{CUSTOMSERVERVERSION}'; Set-Location -Path 'mongodb'; if (Test-Path 'bin/mongod.exe') { (& bin/mongod.exe --version)[0] -match 'db version v(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)' >$null; $InstalledVersion = $matches[1] } else { $InstalledVersion = '' }; if ( [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($MongoDBVersion) ) { $MongoDBVersion = (Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri \"https://endoflife.date/api/v1/products/releases/$MongoDBRelease\").result.latest.name }; if ( $MongoDBVersion -notmatch '^(6|7|8)\.\d+\.\d+$' ) { Write-Output 'Invalid MongoDB version format specified'; exit 1 } elseif ( $InstalledVersion -eq $MongoDBVersion ) { Write-Output \"MongoDB v$MongoDBVersion already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0 } else { if ( Test-Path mongodb.zip ) { Remove-Item mongodb.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://fastdl.mongodb.org/windows/mongodb-windows-x86_64-$MongoDBVersion.zip -OutFile mongodb.zip -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output \"Download failed from the MongoDB CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not GSCS. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; Expand-Archive -Path \"mongodb.zip\" -DestinationPath \".\" -Force *> $null; if ( Test-Path mongodb.zip ) { Remove-Item mongodb.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; if (Test-Path \"mongodb-*\") { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force mongodb -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null; Get-ChildItem -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -like \"mongodb-*\" } | Rename-Item -NewName \"" *> $null; Write-Output \"MongoDB v$MongoDBVersion downloaded\" } }"

deploymentSteps.name: Download MongoDB Shell
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path 'mongodb'; if (Test-Path 'mongosh/bin/mongosh.exe') { $InstalledVersion = & mongosh/bin/mongosh.exe --version } else { $InstalledVersion = '' }; $LatestVersion = (Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri \"https://api.github.com/repos/mongodb-js/mongosh/releases/latest\").name; if ( $InstalledVersion -eq $LatestVersion ) { Write-Output \"MongoDB Shell v$LatestVersion already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0 } else { if ( Test-Path mongosh.zip ) { Remove-Item mongosh.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://downloads.mongodb.com/compass/mongosh-$LatestVersion-win32-x64.zip -OutFile mongosh.zip -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output \"Download failed from the MongoDB CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not GSCS. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; Expand-Archive -Path \"mongosh.zip\" -DestinationPath \".\" -Force *> $null; if ( Test-Path mongosh.zip ) { Remove-Item mongosh.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; if (Test-Path \"mongosh-*\") { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force mongosh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null; Get-ChildItem -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -like \"mongosh-*\" } | Rename-Item -NewName \"mongosh\" *> $null; Write-Output \"MongoDB Shell v$LatestVersion downloaded\" } }"

deploymentSteps.name: Set Up MongoDB
deploymentSteps.arguments: -c "cd . && export PATH=\"{SERVER_DIR}/bin:{SERVER_DIR}/mongosh/bin:$PATH\"; mongosh/bin/mongosh --host 127.0.0.1 --port {GAME_PORT} --quiet --eval \"db.runCommand({ ping: 1 })\" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; bin/mongod --dbpath {SERVER_DIR}/data --port {GAME_PORT} --bind_ip 127.0.0.1 --unixSocketPrefix {SERVER_DIR}/run --logpath {SERVER_DIR}/log/mongod.log --logappend --fork >/dev/null 2>&1; timeout=60; while ((timeout--)); do mongosh/bin/mongosh --host 127.0.0.1 --port {GAME_PORT} --quiet --eval \"db.runCommand({ ping: 1 })\" >/dev/null 2>&1 && break || sleep 1; done; if ((timeout < 0)); then echo \"MongoDB server failed to start for setup. Aborting\"; exit 1; fi; mongosh/bin/mongosh \"mongodb://127.0.0.1:{GAME_PORT}/admin\" --quiet --eval \"try { const adminDb = db.getSiblingDB(\\\"admin\\\"); if (!adminDb.getUser(\\\"admin\\\")) { adminDb.createUser({ user: \\\"admin\\\", pwd: \\\"{ADMINPASSWORD}\\\", roles: [\\\"root\\\"] }); print(\\\"Root user 'admin' created with secure password authentication\\\"); print(\\\"Use GSCS's console to manage the server via the admin user\\\"); } try { if (db.getMongo().getDBNames().includes(\\\"test\\\")) { db.getSiblingDB(\\\"test\\\").dropDatabase(); void 0; } } catch (e) { } } catch (e) { if (e.codeName === \\\"Unauthorized\\\" || e.code === 13) { } else { print(\\\"Failed to connect to MongoDB: \\\" + e); quit(1); } }\"; bin/mongod --shutdown --dbpath {SERVER_DIR}/data >/dev/null 2>&1"

deploymentSteps.name: Set Up MongoDB
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location -Path 'mongodb'; $env:PATH = \"{SERVER_DIR}/bin;{SERVER_DIR}/mongosh\bin;\" + $env:PATH; & mongosh/bin/mongosh.exe --host 127.0.0.1 --port {GAME_PORT} --quiet --eval 'db.runCommand({ ping: 1 })' *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { exit 0 }; Start-Process \"bin/mongod.exe\" -ArgumentList \"--dbpath `\"{SERVER_DIR}/data`\" --port {GAME_PORT} --bind_ip 127.0.0.1 --logpath `\"{SERVER_DIR}/log\mongod.log`\" --logappend\" -RedirectStandardOutput \"NUL\" -WindowStyle Hidden; for ($i=0; $i -lt 60; $i++) { & mongosh/bin/mongosh.exe --host 127.0.0.1 --port {GAME_PORT} --quiet --eval 'db.runCommand({ ping: 1 })' *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { break }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }; if ($i -eq 60) { Write-Output 'MongoDB server failed to start for setup. Aborting'; exit 1 }; & mongosh/bin/mongosh.exe \"mongodb://127.0.0.1:{GAME_PORT}/admin\" --quiet --eval \"try { const adminDb = db.getSiblingDB('admin'); if (!adminDb.getUser('admin')) { adminDb.createUser({ user: 'admin', pwd: '{ADMINPASSWORD}', roles: ['root'] }); print('Root user admin created with secure password authentication'); print('Use the GSCS console to manage the server via the admin user'); } try { if (db.getMongo().getDBNames().includes('test')) { db.getSiblingDB('test').dropDatabase(); void 0; } } catch (e) { } } catch (e) { if (e.codeName === 'Unauthorized' || e.code === 13) { } else { print('Failed to connect to MongoDB: ' + e); quit(1); } }\"; $shutdownOutput = (& mongosh/bin/mongosh.exe \"mongodb://127.0.0.1:{GAME_PORT}/admin\" --username admin --password {ADMINPASSWORD} --authenticationDatabase admin --quiet --eval \"db.shutdownServer()\" 2>&1) -join \"`n\"; if ($shutdownOutput -match \"ECONNRESET\") { $global:LASTEXITCODE = 0 }"

deploymentSteps.name: Run MongoDB Server
deploymentSteps.arguments: -c "cd . && export PATH=\"{SERVER_DIR}/bin:{SERVER_DIR}/mongosh/bin:$PATH\"; export GLIBC_TUNABLES=glibc.pthread.rseq=0; mongosh/bin/mongosh --host 127.0.0.1 --port {GAME_PORT} --quiet --eval \"db.runCommand({ ping: 1 })\" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0 || bin/mongod {CUSTOMSERVEROPTIONS} --auth --config {SERVER_DIR}/mongod.conf --dbpath {SERVER_DIR}/data --port {GAME_PORT} --bind_ip 0.0.0.0 --unixSocketPrefix {SERVER_DIR}/run --logpath {SERVER_DIR}/log/mongod.log --logappend --logRotate rename --fork"

deploymentSteps.name: Run MongoDB Server
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location -Path 'mongodb'; $env:PATH = \"{SERVER_DIR}/bin;{SERVER_DIR}/mongosh\bin;\" + $env:PATH; & mongosh/bin/mongosh.exe --host 127.0.0.1 --port {GAME_PORT} --quiet --eval 'db.runCommand({ ping: 1 })' *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { & bin/mongod.exe {CUSTOMSERVEROPTIONS} --auth --config {SERVER_DIR}/mongod.conf --dbpath \"{SERVER_DIR}/data\" --port {GAME_PORT} --bind_ip 0.0.0.0 --logpath \"{SERVER_DIR}/log\mongod.log\" --logappend --logRotate rename }"

deploymentSteps.name: Wait For Server Start
deploymentSteps.arguments: -c "cd . && export PATH=\"{SERVER_DIR}/mongosh/bin:$PATH\"; timeout=60; while ((timeout--)); do mongosh/bin/mongosh --host 127.0.0.1 --port {GAME_PORT} --quiet --eval \"db.runCommand({ ping: 1 })\" >/dev/null 2>&1 && break || sleep 1; done; if ((timeout < 0)); then echo \"MongoDB server failed to start. Aborting\"; exit 1; fi"

deploymentSteps.name: Wait For Server Start
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location -Path 'mongodb'; $env:PATH = \"{SERVER_DIR}/mongosh\bin;\" + $env:PATH; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 60; $i++) { & mongosh/bin/mongosh.exe --host 127.0.0.1 --port {GAME_PORT} --quiet --eval 'db.runCommand({ ping: 1 })' *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { break }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }; if ($i -eq 60) { Write-Output 'MongoDB server failed to start. Aborting'; exit 1 }"
